settings.q: Is NAD+ safe to use at home?
settings.a: Yes, when used as directed. Each kit is produced in ISO-certified labs, batch-tested for purity, and includes everything for hygienic self-administration plus a step-by-step guide and video. Always speak to your practitioner first if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or managing a health condition.

settings.q: How soon will I feel a difference?
settings.a: Many people report increased energy, clarity and focus within the first week. NAD+ works best taken consistently across the full protocol.

settings.q: How often should I use it?
settings.a: If it is your first time, use one 0.25ml micro-injection daily for the first three days, then move to every other day. Each vial holds roughly 20 doses.

settings.q: Why injection instead of a capsule?
settings.a: Subcutaneous delivery bypasses the digestive system, where much of an oral dose is broken down. That gives NAD+ close to 100% bioavailability, so your cells can use it straight away.

It can sting slightly and small bruises are not unusual. Take the vial out of the fridge about 30 minutes beforehand, as cold solution stings more. Pinch the skin, insert at a 45 degree angle just under the skin, and rotate sites each time.
The needles are for subcutaneous injection, just under the skin into fatty tissue. The stomach, hips or buttocks all work well. Rotate the site with each dose to minimise irritation.

settings.q: Who is NAD+ not suitable for?
settings.a: NAD+ is not suitable for anyone under 18, or with an allergy to NAD+ or sterile solutions. Please avoid it, or speak to your doctor first, if you have or have had: active or previous cancer, pregnancy or breastfeeding, Lyme disease, a recent skin graft, atrial fibrillation, immunosuppression, an organ transplant, or a history of Haemophilus influenzae.

Most people notice none and simply feel alert and energised. Occasionally there can be temporary tiredness for a day or two, or mild sensitivity at the injection site. If that happens, choose a different site next time, and stop if anything feels unusual.

settings.q: What colour should the solution be?
settings.a: A transparent liquid that is either colourless or has a light yellow tint. Both are completely normal.

settings.q: How should I store it, and what is the shelf life?
settings.a: Refrigerate the vial for optimal freshness. Unopened and stored correctly it keeps its quality for 12 months. NAD+ also stays stable at room temperature for several weeks, so a day in transit is no problem.

settings.q: How do I dispose of the needles and vial?
settings.a: Place all used needles and the empty vial into the sharps bin provided, making sure nothing sticks out of the top.

settings.q: How is this different from an IV drip?
settings.a: It delivers the same NAD+ benefits with near 100% bioavailability, but on your own schedule and at a fraction of the cost of in-clinic IV therapy. No appointments, no waiting rooms.
Discreetly and tracked across the UK, packed with a cool pack to keep it in perfect condition. A Certificate of Analysis is available on request.
